name: mpe_agent_scale_core_2026_09_20

statistics.primary: MIF-Aux minus Base, Base+Global16, LAOM-joint, BC within each of 2 sizes and 2 routes; 16 tests one Holm family
statistics.secondary: Graph-Aux minus same four controls within each size and route; separate 16-test Holm family
statistics.adaptation: Adapt minus Frozen for all five latent-policy methods within each size; 10 tests one Holm family
statistics.replication: Average 100 episodes within each independent upstream seed; paired five seed deltas; t95 and exact two-sided sign-flip. Min p=.0625. Do not pool raw returns across sizes.

scope: New independently collected splits and five fresh upstream seeds within existing MPE task; agent-scale extension, not a new environment or zero-shot size transfer. MPE full-visibility route MIF, not MaMuJoCo native masked objective. LAOM is accepted state adapter, not official pixel baseline. Existing results unchanged.
teacher: Collection: high quality, episode-fixed assignment; evaluation: original accepted 23-step dynamic-assignment partners and zero-action warmup. Same within-size observations/labels/evaluation across methods.
access: Curator labels stored separately; observation-only isolated pretraining; label export only after all pretraining freezes. Adapt updates history copies+decoder under budget; no training simulator.
locking: No outcome-dependent seed/model selection, no automatic partial overwrite/retry. Source and pretrained/controller hashes verify before evaluation and completion.
